title: Catch-and-Shoot Partners
description: Partners work on receiving a pass with the feet ready and shooting in rhythm, moving to a new spot after every attempt to build game-like shooting.

content.objective: Catch the ball ready to shoot, with hands up and feet under the body, and release in one smooth motion.
content.setup: Pairs work on each half of the court around the key. One partner is the passer at the elbow with a ball, the other is the shooter, starting at the wing.
instructions: The shooter fakes a defender and moves to a spot, showing hands as a target.
The passer delivers a chest pass to the shooter's shooting pocket on the catch.
The shooter hops or steps into the catch and shoots in one motion.
The passer rebounds and returns the ball with a pass, then the shooter moves to the next spot.
Take five shots at each of five spots, then switch roles.
coachingPoints: Hands up before the ball arrives; the target hand is always ready.
Hop into the catch so the feet are already set for the shot.
Same shooting motion every time: elbow in, follow through, hold the finish.
Passers lead the shooter with a crisp pass at the correct height.
commonMistakes: Catching with the hands down and having to reload the shot.
Standing still rather than moving to the catch.
content.safety: Pairs stay in their own area of the court and rebound immediately to keep balls off the floor.
progressions: Add a closing defender who challenges the shot after the catch.
regressions: Start close to the basket and shoot from a stationary position.
variations: Use a pass fake or a shot fake before the shot.

diagrams.title: Move to the spot, catch, shoot
